name: translate-fr-semantic
summary: Translate an English operational summary and structured facts into French via real sentence-embedding similarity against a fixed template bank.
description: Standalone sibling of report.translate-fr@1.0.0 -- same I/O shape, same ~15-entry EN/FR template bank and glossary -- but matches by cosine similarity of MiniLM-L3 sentence embeddings (threshold 0.72) instead of exact-string/substring matching, so a near-paraphrase of a known Fact line still renders the fixed French template instead of falling through to word-by-word glossary substitution. The embedding model is a hand-rolled #![no_std] BERT-mini forward pass (sentence-transformers/paraphrase-MiniLM-L3-v2, int8-quantized weights compiled into the artifact) -- a real model forward pass at execution time, not a static lookup table. No embeddings/model crate, network, filesystem, or host state; PROJECT/N placeholder filling still requires the literal anchor phrase (a paraphrase that clears the similarity threshold but doesn't carry it falls back to glossary substitution rather than guessing placeholders).

use_cases.scenario: As a rollout coordinator, I want an exact Fact line and a named-project summary translated with placeholders filled, so that French stakeholders see the same deterministic operational narrative as the non-semantic translator.

input_example.summary: Acme Rollout combines distributed browser, edge, and cloud evidence into a deterministic operational summary with 2 validated insights.
structured_facts: Fact: An edge cache exposes regional rollout data with low latency.

output_example.translated_summary: Acme Rollout combine des preuves distribuees du navigateur, de l'edge et du cloud dans un resume operationnel deterministe avec 2 observation(s) validee(s).
translated_facts: Fait : un cache edge expose les donnees de deploiement regional avec une faible latence.

use_cases.scenario: As a rollout coordinator, I want a reworded Fact line that isn't an exact string match to still translate via the fixed French template, so that minor phrasing differences upstream don't degrade to broken word-substitution.

structured_facts: An edge-side cache exposes regional rollout data with very low latency for nearby clients.

translated_facts: Fait : un cache edge expose les donnees de deploiement regional avec une faible latence.

use_cases.scenario: As a rollout coordinator, I want text with no similar template and no glossary terms left untranslated rather than mistranslated, so that unrelated content never gets a false-confidence French rendering.

input_example.summary: The weather in Lisbon was unusually warm this autumn.

output_example.translated_summary: The weather in Lisbon was unusually warm this autumn.

use_cases.scenario: As a rollout coordinator, I want an empty summary and zero facts to translate to empty output rather than inventing text, so that an empty upstream stage stays honestly empty end to end.

preconditions.description: Caller supplies summary string and structured_facts array (either may be empty).

postconditions.description: Identical input yields identical output within one WASM instantiation (verified: 23 unit tests incl. an explicit repeat-call equality assertion). Cross-instantiation / cross-host-architecture byte-identity is NOT proven -- see risk.determinism_class and authoring.test_evidence.

side_effects.description: Produces translated strings in memory; does not log, persist, or transmit inputs.

provenance.author: enricopiovesan
provenance.spec_ref: registry#455 (first spec 001 FR-017 agent) / UMA chapter-13-portable-mcp-runtime/translator-ai-wasi (enricopiovesan/UMA-code-examples) -- algorithm/template bank/glossary ported, tract-onnx model loading rewritten from scratch as #![no_std]

authoring.test_evidence: capability-src/report-translate-fr-semantic: 23 #[test] cases (BRT1 header parse, WordPiece lookup/split/OOV/overlong-word/sequence-cap, embed shape/finiteness/determinism/differs-by-input, cosine self-similarity, LayerNorm zero-mean, GELU monotonicity, template-bank shape, PROJECT/N placeholder extraction incl. no-anchor fallback, glossary substitution, empty-input short-circuit, full translate() wiring) against a tiny synthetic fixture; cargo llvm-cov functions=100%, lines=98.03%, regions=96.66%. Separately verified end to end against the real published Xenova/paraphrase-MiniLM-L3-v2 ONNX graph (onnxruntime, dynamic int8 quantization): mean-pooled L2-normalized embedding cosine ~0.99 across report.* sentences using this capability's own int8 quantization scheme; template-vs-unrelated-sentence cosine ~0.12; identical-text cosine 1.0. Ran the built --features full-model artifact under wasmtime: an exact Fact-template match and a hand-written paraphrase of it (not an exact string) both correctly render the full French template (the deterministic report.translate-fr@1.0.0 falls through the paraphrase to broken half-translated glossary substitution on the same input); an unrelated sentence passes through untranslated rather than false-matching. Cross-arch (x86_64 vs aarch64) byte-identity was NOT verified -- no x86_64 host or emulator was available in the authoring environment -- hence risk.determinism_class: model_derived rather than deterministic (spec 024). License: sentence-transformers/paraphrase-MiniLM-L3-v2 and its Xenova/paraphrase-MiniLM-L3-v2 ONNX conversion are both Apache-2.0, redistribution-safe; recorded in capability-src/report-translate-fr-semantic/data/README.md.
